item.title: TANVI RATNA: With one war, Trump is breaking Middle East's old power structure
item.summary: U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran signal more than war — they represent a deliberate attempt to force a Middle East realignment, this analysis argues.

item.title: Israel looking for 'solutions' to open Christian sites after barring church leader on Palm Sunday due to war
item.summary: Jerusalem's Church of the Holy Sepulchre closed on Palm Sunday under Israeli wartime rules, drawing rebukes from the Catholic Church and Italy.

item.title: Olena Zelenska warns abducted Ukranian kids may take ‘dozens of years’ to return, praises Melania Trump’s help
item.summary: Olena Zelenska credits Melania Trump's advocacy for spotlighting Ukraine's push to recover thousands of children reportedly taken by Russia since 2022.

item.title: Sen Ron Johnson says Senate is 'broken' and calls for ending the filibuster over DHS funding fight
item.summary: Sen. Ron Johnson says Republicans should end the Senate filibuster, blaming Democrats for the DHS funding deadlock and ongoing government shutdown.

item.title: UFC fighter Alexa Grasso delivers vicious KO to Maycee Barber
item.summary: UFC flyweight fighter Alexa Grasso viciously knocked out Maycee Barber during their fight at UFC Seattle on Saturday night. She's emerged as a contender for the title

item.title: Kurt Russell reflects on humble upbringing, says he once lived in an attic in LA
item.summary: Kurt Russell recalls living in an attic in East LA as a child after his father left baseball to pursue acting, reflecting on his humble beginnings.

item.title: Border czar Tom Homan rips Congress for paid vacation as TSA agents struggle without pay
item.summary: Border czar Tom Homan told CNN’s Jake Tapper that unpaid TSA agents were "struggling" to feed their families and pay rent, while Congress remained stuck in a funding fight.

item.title: Vacation rental near Yosemite allegedly used to secretly record guests, 4,000 illegal files found
item.summary: A Madera County man faces felony charges after detectives allegedly found over 4,000 child sexual abuse files at a vacation rental near Yosemite.

item.title: Over 2 dozen children among 33 bodies pulled from Kenyan mass grave: authorities
item.summary: At least 33 bodies, including 25 children, were unearthed from a mass grave in Kericho, Kenya, as authorities investigate a reported hospital morgue transfer.

item.title: Nick Cannon backs President Trump and speaks out on ‘conservative’ views
item.summary: Nick Cannon backs Trump and agrees to Amber Rose's claim that "Democrats don't care about Black people" during candid political chat with her on his talk show.
